newsArray.title: India Set to Welcome Brazil for Historic Football Friendly
newsArray.description: India is gearing up to host Brazil, the five-time world champions, for a historic football friendly on October 3 in Kolkata. Tickets for this much-anticipated match are now available, marking a significant moment in Indian football history. The encounter will feature Brazil, currently ranked fifth in the world, making it the highest-ranked opponent India has faced since the FIFA World Rankings began. Additionally, India will also play against Panama on September 26 and Uruguay on October 6, making this a busy period for the national team. Fans are eager to witness these high-profile matches.
creator: narendra chaudhary
